limits: 2025 publications do not automatically describe the pinned 2026 source.
The user identifies as R.W. Morse; the papers list Roman W. Morse as a coauthor.
Existing evidence is audited; no new experimental solver run or MATLAB execution is claimed.

scope_and_status_rules: Full parity targets the pinned documented implementation; promises of future physics in the 2025 papers are not already implemented requirements.
The requirement, option and public-method inventories overlap; do not add their counts or compute an overall completion percentage.
Implementation, native tests, MATLAB agreement, physical consistency and experimental comparison are separate axes.
passed_scoped refers only to cited cases and criteria. It does not mean the whole requirement or operating range is closed.
A declared enum or matching method name is not a branch test or numerical reference comparison.
Dependencies apply to acceptance of the relevant subcase. They do not prevent exploratory execution, investigation, or independent work on other cases.
Preserve governing equations and original core tolerances. Diagnose translation errors separately from intentional approximations, source defects and calibration choices.
No new numerical calculation, MATLAB execution or experimental validation is claimed by this acceptance-matrix audit.
Original PDFs and raw extracted text remain local; source hashes and analytical citations identify them without redistributing the files.

acceptance_criteria: Implement documented native writer/converter/report functions or identify an explicitly approved native replacement for each upstream operation.
Round-trip scalar, vector, multiwall matrix, enum, boolean, sentinel and multiple-record inputs without dimensional/value loss.
Retain field descriptions, identifiers and default-versus-user-supplied provenance.
requirements.next_action: Implement the generic input export/report layer and round-trip acceptance fixtures.

requirements.requirement: Define a reproducible native contract for source function-valued input.
requirements.scope: CBTMULT and any original function expressions; preserve the function's evaluated values without treating serialized MATLAB text as trusted instructions.
requirements.gap: Python API callables and constant GUI multipliers work; arbitrary MATLAB expressions are rejected and callable behavior is not fully serializable. There is no cross-runtime function-evaluation reference corpus.
acceptance_criteria: List each supported original expression and define its native callable or safe structured-function representation.
Compare evaluated values at mesh, transition and boundary points against independent source values.
Store a reproducible function specification and evaluated mesh values; unsupported expressions must fail explicitly.
requirements.next_action: Inventory actual function expressions in source inputs and database adapters before extending the parser.

requirements.requirement: Preserve geometry, wall orientation, units and time-dependent boundary meaning.
requirements.scope: ANGLE uses degrees from vertical in Geometry.m despite a radians comment in geom.inp; WPOWER rows are segments and columns are walls; NNODES means cells.
requirements.gap: Column-major wall reshaping and selected boundary/geometry rules are checked, but nonzero-angle and broad multiwall source-export comparisons are absent.
acceptance_criteria: Check hydraulic diameter, wall fractions, axial length and segment power integration with explicit units.
Compare asymmetric two-wall inputs and nonzero-angle cases to source values without transposing walls or converting degrees as radians.
Reject unordered times, incompatible segment/wall shapes and invalid boundary values before solving.
requirements.next_action: Create asymmetric geometry/power and nonzero-angle reference cases before importing experimental configurations.

requirements.requirement: Verify every supported interpolation method and public coordinate convention.
requirements.scope: Positive-step MATLAB colon; LINEAR, NEAREST, NEXT, PREVIOUS, PCHIP, SPLINE and MAKIMA; singleton, endpoint, midpoint, extrapolation and multidimensional ordinate cases.
requirements.gap: Selected colon/nearest/next semantics are tested. Higher-order method equivalence and public interpolation convenience wrappers are not established. Ambiguous CUBIC is explicitly unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: Freeze independent MATLAB vectors for each supported method, node count, tie and extrapolation case with dimensions retained.
Verify axis-zero interpolation and MATLAB half-way tie behavior without accidental broadcasting.
Resolve CUBIC against the pinned MATLAB release or retain its explicit unsupported status; do not silently alias it.
requirements.next_action: Add method-by-method reference fixtures and public-wrapper acceptance cases.

requirements.requirement: Preserve source update order, indexing and shared-state relationships.
requirements.scope: MATLAB one-based/linear indexing versus zero-based NumPy; column-major multiwall copies; state caches and handle references in all four frameworks.
requirements.gap: Four selected trajectories provide indirect coverage; explicit copy/setter/alias contracts and arbitrary subsets are not independently compared across the full API. Method audit retains two setter-contract review entries.
acceptance_criteria: For each source copy/update operation, specify which arrays are copied, shared, preserved or recomputed and in what order.
Use asymmetric multiwall and duplicate/subset fixtures to expose column/row and linear-index errors.
Compare actual object-graph relationships and before/after cache values for transient and initialization paths.
requirements.next_action: Close the two setter-contract review entries and add targeted source-export state-transition fixtures.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the native CoolProp backend, clamping and pressure contract.
requirements.scope: BICUBIC&HEOS property calls with HEOS surface tension, SATURATED/PSYSTEM branches, pressure bounds, scalar/array shapes and boundary-pressure diagnostics.
requirements.gap: Native HEOS consistency and selected archived solver states are checked; property-by-property MATLAB equivalence across fluids, pressures, enthalpy bounds and CoolProp versions is unverified. The low-table-bound inversion discrepancy is retained.
acceptance_criteria: Compare exported property tables at interior and limiting states for every supported property mode with pinned CoolProp version/backend.
Keep dimensional identities, pressure range, saturation ordering, clamping and scalar/array return contracts explicit.
Document the 6 MPa lower-table inversion discrepancy and do not replace source enthalpy clamping with a temperature correction.
requirements.next_action: Create a property reference grid and boundary-condition pressure mismatch cases before broad experimental runs.

requirements.requirement: Resolve QKMAX optimization equivalence and external wrapper API boundaries.
requirements.scope: SciPy bounded optimization of the source Kutateladze expression versus MATLAB fminbnd; optional property plot and general wrapper helpers.
requirements.gap: QKMAX exists and has native bounds/scale checks but its optimizer result is not MATLAB-verified. Property plotting, humid-air and general wrapper unit-conversion utilities are not fully ported; these external utilities are outside the 585-method inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Compare maximizing pressure and heat-flux value with explicit Pa and W/m^2 tolerances justified against the source optimization settings.
State whether each general external-wrapper utility is part of the port acceptance scope; runtime independence does not require reimplementing unused MATLAB wrappers.
Provide direct native replacements for required property plotting/conversion operations and test unit conversions independently.
requirements.next_action: Export QKMAX reference values and inventory required versus unused external-wrapper operations.

requirements.requirement: Audit public numerical method contracts beyond matching names.
requirements.scope: All 585 non-constructor entries in the existing 25-class inventory; inherited repetitions are not unique implemented capabilities.
requirements.gap: 447 name candidates, 54 partial/internal alternatives, 77 infrastructure/presentation gaps, five explicit unsupported entries and two setter reviews are declaration classifications, not acceptance outcomes. Only selected diagnostics have behavior tests or archive comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: Attach every inventory entry to a requirement and fixture, including arguments, index selections, dimensions, units and failure semantics.
Compare stored, derived and computed-on-demand quantities separately; preserve errors for source-defective diagnostics.
Do not use a same-name method or a declaration count as proof of equation or operating-domain parity.
requirements.next_action: Join the method inventory to this acceptance ledger and prioritize public diagnostics needed by dataset adapters.

requirements.component: Live-field extraction and public interpolation API
requirements.requirement: Complete generic transient/struct extraction and interpolation convenience methods.
requirements.scope: Arbitrary public live-field quantities, nested subobjects and physical/pseudo-time state selection.
requirements.gap: SavedResults handles only saved numeric quantities; it cannot reproduce arbitrary source method evaluation. Public interpolation wrappers and generic live-field struct/transient behavior remain missing or internal.
acceptance_criteria: Extract selected quantities from live fields with explicit time/node/wall shapes and preserve nested path identity.
Match source values for methods as well as stored properties without confusing pseudo-time and physical time.
Unsupported unsaved closures must raise an explicit error rather than inventing or silently omitting a result.
requirements.next_action: Implement a public quantity-query contract and verify it on saved and unsaved source methods.

requirements.requirement: Document and test native equivalents of Session, logging, solver state and output-directory rules.
requirements.scope: Named sessions, directory creation, logging modes, warnings, no-overwrite behavior, cancellation and restart semantics.
requirements.gap: Native progress, metadata, locks and worker logs exist; MATLAB diary/class/session option parity is not complete. Stronger native convergence/physical rejection signals need an explicit mapping to upstream STATE rather than being called identical.
acceptance_criteria: Map every public session/logging option and solver state to the native behavior or documented replacement.
Verify failed, cancelled and resumed runs cannot masquerade as completed results or overwrite previous evidence.
Retain distinct numerical, reference and physical statuses in all interfaces.
requirements.next_action: Write the session/state compatibility table and add remaining restart/logging acceptance cases.

requirements.requirement: Complete the numerical data contract for all solver outputs.
requirements.scope: NPZ/CSV/JSON, coordinates, units, metadata, effective inputs, initialization histories and mixture precursors; MATLAB class-object serialization is a separate unsupported format.
requirements.gap: Core selected archived outputs are compared, but full derived-output completeness, arbitrary callables and MATLAB object reload compatibility are not established. Exact .mat class serialization is not implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Every exported quantity has audited units, dimensions, coordinates and source provenance; retain nonfinite values and flag their validity.
Round-trip all four native schemas with allow_pickle=False and verify values without implicit squeezing or interpolation.
List every source output unavailable from the portable native format; do not describe NPZ loading as MATLAB object reconstruction.
requirements.next_action: Add an output-field completeness ledger and full-schema round-trip fixtures for supported transient and multiwall cases.

requirements.requirement: Verify implemented plots as faithful displays of saved arrays.

requirements.gap: Seventeen plotting checks and rendered examples establish exact selected values/layout semantics, not visual identity with MATLAB or correctness of the underlying physics.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm every plotted line/frame/cell corresponds to the selected saved values and actual time/node/wall coordinates.
Retain units, failed-physical-status warnings and nonfinite gaps; reject incompatible selections.
Keep playback speed distinct from physical time and retain frame-count/timing evidence.
requirements.next_action: Retain these tests and add any missing quantity/schema cases exposed by experimental comparison plots.

requirements.requirement: Close source plot options and live-calculation display gaps.

requirements.gap: Unsupported source plotting keywords are rejected; saved-array plots and GUI charts provide only a subset of upstream presentation/workflow behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory each public plot keyword and grouped quantity selection with an equivalent native operation or approved format replacement.
Verify masks and overlays against the numerical onset/obstruction coordinates rather than visual resemblance alone.
Test exported frame/data values, labels and orientation; do not let presentation defaults alter the numerical data.
requirements.next_action: Prioritize masks/overlays and quantities needed by validation, then remaining presentation/export options.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the complete quick-start workflow for all four frameworks.

Retain all four original input selections and their separate convergence, archived agreement and physical statuses.
Explain native serialization/plotting replacements without claiming MATLAB class-object parity.
requirements.next_action: Create a runnable tutorial01 acceptance script with explicit per-operation expected outcomes.

requirements.requirement: Cover every original model tutorial operation and case selection.

acceptance_criteria: Enumerate every tutorial case and public operation, including conditional branches and expected errors.
Provide native runnable equivalents and link each numerical claim to a CORE acceptance row and independent reference.
Report unsupported operations and source-defective options rather than silently changing tutorial physics.
requirements.next_action: Extract the four Live Script workflows into a case/operation manifest and native acceptance examples.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce input inspection, equivalent INP/JSON loading and conversion workflows.

acceptance_criteria: Match effective values and wall dimensions between original INP and equivalent JSON cases.
Execute every tutorial inspection/conversion operation and verify round-trip output.
Make default usage and unsupported expression differences visible.
requirements.next_action: Implement API-003 and add the native tutorial06 end-to-end acceptance script.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce diagnostic and discretization-study workflows.
requirements.scope: Point, pseudo-time and physical-time distinctions; mesh/time-step comparisons; thresholds and failure reporting without asserting unsupported convergence order.
requirements.gap: Existing sensitivity studies and diagnostics are narrower than complete tutorial operations or all-framework asymptotic convergence evidence; some tightened cases fail.
acceptance_criteria: Provide reproducible studies that preserve all input differences and distinguish iterative, temporal and spatial error.
Link every reported convergence claim to an executed sequence with raw values, units and failures retained.
Verify tutorial diagnostic extraction against source arrays; do not interpret smooth plots as validation.
requirements.next_action: Build tutorial07/08 scripts around the existing sensitivity tools and close missing diagnostic APIs.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the complete advanced post-processing workflow with explicit format replacements.
requirements.scope: Animation, point histories, time-elevation surfaces, extracted tables/CSV and save/reload operations.
requirements.gap: History, maps, GIF and portable reload exist, but a complete tutorial09 operation manifest and full surface/video/grouped plotting behavior are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Execute a native equivalent for each tutorial operation on the same saved transient data.
Compare extracted numerical tables, selection axes and frame values independently of chart styling.
Identify approved native output-format substitutions explicitly and keep unsupported options visible.
requirements.next_action: Create the tutorial09 workflow ledger and implement remaining scientific display operations before cosmetic parity.

requirements.requirement: Execute and verify the portable exporter against a known MATLAB environment.
requirements.scope: Fresh and approved-object source modes for all four frameworks, arbitrary selected model/boundary cases, initialization and precursor arrays.
requirements.gap: Exporter source was reviewed but never executed in MATLAB. Synthetic comparator fixtures do not verify successful class construction, CoolProp compatibility, export dimensions or version capture.
acceptance_criteria: Run a fresh reference export in an available compatible MATLAB installation and retain its execution log, exact source/submodule/CoolProp/MATLAB versions and input hashes.
Require complete primary arrays, audited units/shapes, coordinates and convergence histories; optional method errors remain explicit.
Do not overwrite original archives; compare an independently produced export without interpolation or tolerance changes.
requirements.next_action: Obtain known-runtime exports for the first transient/alternative-closure acceptance cases; MATLAB remains unnecessary for normal Python execution.

requirements.requirement: Keep structural MAT5/MCOS recovery auditable and correctly scoped.

requirements.gap: Recovery works for the four actual archives; original producing MATLAB/CoolProp/source versions remain unknown. Reconstructed baseline methods are not independent fresh MATLAB executions or a generic decoder for all future cases.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve before/after archive hashes, object identity and original dimensions; record every stored versus reconstructed quantity.
Fail on unsupported models, decoder warnings and missing required data rather than guessing arrays.
Retain unknown producer metadata and prohibit extending baseline reconstruction formulas to other physics without audit.
requirements.next_action: Use the existing immutable archives as scoped anchors; add independent known-runtime references rather than claiming recovery supplies all needed cases.

requirements.requirement: Maintain trustworthy comparisons for fresh exports and recovered archives.
requirements.scope: Core W/U/H and required FourField base/frequency, histories/precursors, inputs, units, shapes and convergence; supplementary diagnostics separately identified.
requirements.gap: Four original core baselines pass; supplementary diagnostic differences remain. GUI comparisons have a narrower scope than the full archived audit. Original 1e-8/0 criteria must not be mistaken for a universal experimental or all-quantity accuracy tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve original core rtol=1e-8 and atol=0, exact zeros and exact shape/unit checks; no interpolation, broadcasting or missing-field skips.
Audit new quantity-specific absolute/relative criteria before comparisons, with dimensional justification and provenance; never change criteria merely to obtain a pass.
Keep synthetic tooling-test passes, actual reference agreement and physical consistency as separate results.
requirements.next_action: Extend immutable adversarial fixtures and explicit comparison scopes for each new reference case.

requirements.requirement: Preserve a usable local front end without overstating scientific coverage.
requirements.scope: Four steady presets, 163 inputs, units/reference/defaults, validated edits, saved results and plots; native solvers also have transient schedules.
requirements.gap: GUI coverage is intentionally steady-only; arbitrary functions and transient scheduling are absent. Four preset comparisons do not establish every edited combination, keyboard/screen-reader accessibility or full solver API parity.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure supported inputs retain units, references/defaults and explicit unsupported/inactive explanations.
Keep errors, cancellation, custom-case identity and numerical/reference/physical statuses accurate across GUI and CLI.
If transient GUI support becomes a requirement, add schedule editing and physical/pseudo-time safeguards without changing solver equations.
requirements.next_action: Keep native parity independent of UI completion; extend GUI scheduling only after transient numerical acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Retain clean Windows installation, package contents and no-MATLAB runtime independence.
requirements.scope: Pinned Python 3.12 dependencies, source/wheel installation, CLI/GUI launches, bundled inputs/reference/assets/licenses and runtime import boundaries.
requirements.gap: The clean Windows workflow passed213 Python tests and5 JavaScript tests with2 recorded FourField warnings. This confirms the tested installation/runtime scope, not all operating conditions or scientific parity. Test/evidence versions must remain traceable after changes.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce installation and actual solver execution from a clean recursive checkout and installed wheel without MATLAB, Engine or Octave.
Verify bundled arrays/assets/licenses, dependency consistency and source/reference fingerprints.
Require all applicable tests and disclosed warnings/physical failures in release evidence; do not sum overlapping historical test suites.
requirements.next_action: Keep CI and installed-wheel smoke checks as release gates for every future numerical change.

requirements.requirement: Keep the acceptance ledger and historical evidence internally consistent.
requirements.scope: Source/submodule/data commits, artifact hashes, units, input identity, independent test scopes and stale documentation wording.
requirements.gap: Historical checkpoints and independent evidence scopes need continuing reconciliation as the acceptance ledger expands; method counts and test counts are not a complete acceptance denominator. Source/archive producer metadata remain unknown where explicitly recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Each requirement row has stable ID, pinned source anchor, executable case, units/domain, independent evidence and separate implementation/equivalence/physical/experimental status.
Mark earlier checkpoints as historical and distinguish unexecuted fresh exports from completed archive recovery/comparisons.
Verify source/evidence paths and hashes; missing evidence cannot become a pass because an implementation is present.
requirements.next_action: Maintain the machine-readable ledger, pinned provenance and accurate historical/current status wording together as each new case is accepted.

requirements.requirement: Define distinct publication, companion and pinned-code targets
requirements.scope: 2025 ICMF abstracts, 2025 NURETH paper, 2026 pinned solver and database revisions

Keep 5 m ICMF and 5.5 m NURETH cases distinct; preserve explicit perimeter/area and inlet enthalpy rather than replacing them with rounded paper values.
Document which current-code changes differ from the publication-time implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Archive exact generated inputs, closure selections and any sequential inheritance of options.
Obtain independent numerical reference arrays for all plotted quantities and compare on matched coordinates with predeclared justified criteria.
Check convergence and applicable balances; retain source-shared physical failures separately from equivalence results.

Separate physical time from initialization pseudo-time and retain moving annular-domain eligibility.
Compare transient wave flow, velocity and frequency against independent arrays; quantify timestep/mesh sensitivity.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the two-fluid code-to-code comparison without calling it experimental validation

acceptance_criteria: Identify TRACE version, complete input deck, numerical settings, selected closures and output units.
Compare matched phase quantities and domains without treating another code as experimental truth.
Record whether data were rerun, recovered or digitized; plot digitization cannot establish full-precision equivalence.
requirements.next_action: Recover the TRACE reference case and arrays if available; keep the benchmark outside experimental-validation counts.

requirements.requirement: Implement native reading, selection and case input generation
requirements.scope: All six inspected experimental families; inherited Dataset behavior, explicit overrides and transient schedule semantics
requirements.gap: No native database adapter or executed measured-versus-predicted workflow exists.
acceptance_criteria: Retain raw XML values, missing entries, repeated fields, record identifiers, source hashes and citations.
Match geometry, pressure, inlet enthalpy, mass flow, power, axial heating and default/override precedence.
Verify mass flux times area equals mass flow and integrated prescribed heating equals power within documented input precision.
For transient partial records, match initial-state inheritance rather than silently inheriting a previous transient record.
requirements.next_action: Implement the reader/input adapter with unit-aware fixture and generated-input comparisons before any validation pass claim.

requirements.requirement: Match the actual measured quantity and coordinate system
requirements.scope: Film/base/wave quantities, void fraction, quality, heat transfer and dryout measurements
requirements.gap: No shared observation adapter tracks direct/derived status, measurement coordinates and source-specific units.
acceptance_criteria: Carry SI dimensions while preserving raw units; explicitly distinguish wave number density (m^-1), frequency (Hz), period (s), and velocity (m/s).
Use period=1/f and frequency=U_wave*N only with verified source definitions; track derived quantities and correlated uncertainties.
Record axial origin and use within-domain interpolation with stated numerical error; no silent clamping or extrapolation.
Missing measurements remain missing and relative errors are not computed with physically meaningless near-zero denominators.
requirements.next_action: Create per-observable transformations and tests before aggregating dataset errors.

requirements.requirement: Establish evidence-based validation criteria
requirements.scope: Measurement, digitization/transcription, input and numerical uncertainty for each compared quantity
requirements.gap: The overview papers and database do not supply a complete quantitative uncertainty budget or predeclared acceptance bands.
acceptance_criteria: Recover original experimental uncertainty and distinguish it from digitization/transcription and numerical uncertainty.
Document uncertainty propagation and correlations; label unavailable uncertainty as unknown.
Allow descriptive comparisons with unknown uncertainty but prohibit an uncertainty-based pass claim.
Predeclare criteria before fitting; do not adopt plotting guides or baseline 1e-8 tolerances as experimental accuracy thresholds.
requirements.next_action: Build quantity-specific uncertainty/acceptance records from original reports and numerical-sensitivity results.

requirements.requirement: Produce reproducible per-case and aggregate validation evidence
requirements.scope: All attempted cases, including nonconvergence, physical inconsistency and excluded measurements
requirements.gap: Current result output supports solver diagnostics but not a complete experimental comparison ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Publish paired measured/calculated tables with dimensional signed errors, bias, MAE and RMSE for defined populations.
Report every attempted case and exclusion reason; do not hide nonconverged or physically inconsistent cases in aggregate scores.
Archive inputs, code/property/data versions, settings, sensitivity and comparison scripts.
Limit conclusions to measured quantities and tested fluid/geometry/regime/model configurations.
requirements.next_action: Implement a validation report generator around the native solver outputs after adapter/observable checks.

requirements.requirement: Execute the first measured-versus-calculated mixture cases

acceptance_criteria: Select traceable representative records with matched geometry, heating, inlet state and measured void definition.
Freeze the selected mixture thermal/void closures before evaluation.
Demonstrate converged iterative/mesh settings and applicable balances; publish all paired measurements and errors.
State whether uncertainty permits acceptance or only descriptive comparison.
requirements.next_action: Use a small Bartolomey case set as the first end-to-end adapter and reporting milestone.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the selected NURETH Figure 6 comparisons

Compare mm only as a display conversion from stored metres; match m/s velocity and m^-1 number density separately.
Establish adequate adiabatic development and numerical/physical eligibility at the observation location.
Label this as publication/calibration-associated reproduction; do not infer coverage of all 3-9 MPa or annular-geometry measurements from the selected 7 MPa plot groups.
requirements.next_action: Resolve EXP-013, run the companion selection, and publish explicit comparison/uncertainty results.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the selected NURETH Figure 7 comparisons

Compare wave velocity and period at correctly transformed measurement locations, retaining equilibrium-period curves as predictions rather than measurements.
Check downstream-domain eligibility, annular masks, iterative convergence and spatial/temporal sensitivity where applicable.
Report the source-associated calibration status and all rejected/out-of-domain points.

Reconcile the source measurement/geometry coordinate definitions against the original Sawai article and documented digitization.
Do not clamp, extrapolate, extend channel length or silently discard points to make comparisons look valid.
Until resolved, report affected points as ineligible for within-domain error metrics with explicit reasons.

requirements.requirement: Resolve paper-to-companion and companion-to-solver inconsistencies

acceptance_criteria: Preserve immutable original sources and document each discrepancy with exact anchors.
Resolve historical target/version intent before claiming publication reproduction.

requirements.requirement: Separate model development, calibration-associated reproduction and independent evaluation

Report calibration-associated reproduction separately from independent validation.

Compare measured film flow directly; mark any inferred droplet flow as derived.
Resolve applicable convergence/area/balance eligibility and report uncertainty and closure choices.
Avoid claiming transferability beyond the tested conditions.

Treat missing onset location as missing, not zero.
Use a framework/closure applicable to the thermal regime and qualify its limits.
Report numerical and experimental uncertainties, failure cases and derived inlet-subcooling transformations.

requirements.requirement: Validate critical-power search and CHF comparisons as distinct algorithms and observables

Separate axial-solver errors from outer-search errors.
Document whether selected measured records supported the assessed CHF correlation's development.
Preserve model-domain exclusions, measurement uncertainty and all attempted cases.

requirements.component: Model applicability versus promised future features
requirements.requirement: Enforce the supplied papers' domain limits without expanding parity into future model development
requirements.scope: Single-component straight constant-area flow; annular thermal equilibrium through film dryout; pinned source overrides general overview prose
requirements.gap: Documented limits lack a complete case-level domain/eligibility matrix; paper broad stability/consistency statements cannot waive observed numerical or physical failures.
acceptance_criteria: Tag each acceptance case with fluid, geometry, thermal regime, closure domain and supported boundary conditions.
Treat experimental agreement only as evidence within the tested domain.
Do not count proposed multicomponent, variable-area or thermally nonequilibrium annular extensions as missing translations unless supported by pinned upstream.
Keep nonlinear convergence and mesh/timestep accuracy tests despite the paper's backward-Euler stability discussion.
requirements.next_action: Add case-level applicability gates and preserve explicit errors for unsupported paths.
